signals.text: 'He could be happier' - why is Estevao becoming Chelsea's forgotten man?. Estevao faces limited opportunities at Chelsea as Pedro Neto’s form and competition for places in attack leave him struggling for game time under Xabi Alonso.

'He knows his role' - Rulli provides heroics but no worries for Donnarumma. Geronimo Rulli's penalty shootout heroics may have put the pressure on Gianluigi Donnarumma at Manchester City, but manager Enzo Maresca has no doubt about his number one.
Sesko ruled out until January with shin injury. Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko is expected to be out until at least January with a shin injury.
